title: Variants of Beam Search for DiskANN
abstract: arXiv:2611.26609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph-based data structures such as DiskANN, HNSW, and NSG constitute the state of the art for large-scale approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search. Indyk and Xu introduced the notion of $\alpha$-reachable graphs, which include graphs built by DiskANN's slow-preprocessing construction, and proved that greedy search achieves an approximation factor of $\tfrac{\alpha+1}{\alpha-1}$. Independently, Al-Jazzazi et al. proposed adaptive beam search (ABS) with a relaxation parameter $\gamma > 0$, showing a $\tfrac{2}{\gamma}$ approximation on navigable graphs ($\alpha \approx 1$), where greedy search admits no guarantees. In this work, we unify and generalize these results by proving that ABS with parameter $\gamma$ on $\alpha$-reachable graphs achieves an approximation of $\tfrac{\alpha+1}{\alpha(\gamma+1)-1}$ for any metric. tldr: 本文统一并推广了贪心搜索与自适应束搜索在 α-可达图上的理论保证，证明了自适应束搜索在任意度量下可实现 (α+1)/(α(γ+1)-1) 的近似因子，填补了贪心搜索在可导航图上无保证的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies and generalizes the approximation guarantees of greedy search and adaptive beam search (ABS), proving that ABS achieves an approximation factor of (α+1)/(α(γ+1)-1) on α-reachable graphs for any metric, where greedy search offers no guarantees.
